description: March 30 birthday meaning: Aries decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a March 30 birthday falls in Aries, in the first decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: March 30 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The last day of the first Aries decan, March 30 places the Sun about nine degrees into the sign, with Mars as ruler and sub-ruler. Thirty reduces to 3, adding showmanship and wit. The combination is traditionally linked with vivid self-expression, from performance to sport, and with an infectious enthusiasm that rallies others.

On March 30 the Sun usually sits at about 9° Aries, in the first decan, where Mars rules the decan as well as the sign. The opening stretch of Aries, from 0 to 9 degrees, is often called the purest expression of the sign, because Mars governs Aries and also acts as sub-ruler here. Astrologers traditionally picture this decan as the spark at the very start of the zodiac: quick to move, frank in speech and happiest with something to push against. The doubled Mars emphasis tends to sharpen courage and an appetite for challenge, and it can also shorten patience with slow processes. Many of these Rams recognise the urge to start before the plan is finished. Their growing edge is usually learning that a pause is not the same as a defeat.

sections.heading: March 30 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one March 30 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on March 30: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 30 is the 89th day of the year (90th in a leap year). By April 20, 21 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Taurus.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by March 30, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on March 30 include Vincent van Gogh (1853), Francisco Goya (1746) and Céline Dion (1968).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 30?
faq.answer: March 30 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Aries, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 30 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 30?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a March 30 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 30?
faq.answer: March 30 is also the birthday of Vincent van Gogh (1853), Francisco Goya (1746) and Céline Dion (1968). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
